en.headline: Cathay Pacific to pay one-month discretionary bonus to eligible Hong Kong staff
en.dek: Eligible Hong Kong-based employees will receive the 2026 bonus equivalent to one month of qualifying pay on 7 January, the airline said in an internal message.
body: Cathay Pacific Airways has told staff it will pay a 2026 discretionary bonus equivalent to one month of qualifying pay to eligible Hong Kong-based employees on 7 January next year.

According to an internal message from the airline’s people director on Thursday, the award forms part of the carrier’s total pay and benefits approach and marks the fourth consecutive year the company has shared business gains with staff. Local management teams will brief eligible colleagues in mainland China and other regions on their arrangements.

The announcement matches the one-month bonus paid to eligible Hong Kong staff last year. Unlike last year’s communication, this year’s message did not mention a salary increase. Last year eligible Hong Kong employees received an average pay rise of 3.5 per cent effective from 1 January 2026.

Cathay previously reported an attributable profit of HK$6.243 billion for the six months to 30 June this year, up nearly 71 per cent year on year. As of December 2025 the group employed more than 33,000 people worldwide, including about 28,000 in Hong Kong.

zh.headline: 國泰向香港合資格員工發放一個月酌情花紅
zh.dek: 航空公司在內部訊息中表示，常駐香港的合資格員工將於明年1月7日獲發相當於一個月合資格薪酬的2026年度酌情花紅。
body: 國泰航空周四向員工宣布，將向常駐香港的合資格員工發放2026年度酌情花紅，金額相當於一個月合資格薪酬，於明年1月7日支付。
人事董事的內部訊息指出，這是公司全面薪酬福利的一部分，亦是連續第四年與員工分享業務成果。內地及其他地區的合資格同事將由當地管理團隊另行說明安排。
今次宣布與去年向香港合資格員工發放的一個月花紅相同。與去年不同的是，今年訊息未有提及加薪。去年合資格香港員工平均獲加薪3.5%，由2026年1月1日起生效。
國泰早前公布截至今年6月30日止六個月股東應佔溢利62.43億港元，按年增長近71%。截至2025年12月，集團全球僱用逾33,000人，其中約28,000人在香港。
